source: Summarised from the SkyMyce repository's release commits. The newest entry is the fallback version shown when the release service cannot be reached.

notes: Greenhouse Planner overlay for the Garden.
Appearance settings reduced to theme presets and a graphics mode.
One Community data sharing setting replaces the per-category switches.
Removed the RNG Drop Tester, Player Wealth and Loans & Lending.
Tick-path performance work.
Faster price refreshes in the tracker by reusing run history.
The Crush Camera prepares its views ahead of time.
The friend list saves without blocking the game.
Graphics performance work and hot-path fixes.
Status bars restyled.
Goldor map switches sections on gate lines.
Status bar editor with separate, movable bars.
NPC dialogue box with numbered options.
Press Enter to finish Auction House, Bazaar and bank signs.
Progress bar on the skill XP widget.
Goldor coordination: gold-standard class strategies with step guides and conditions.
Status bars, a level card and the Levels page.
Item art in the RNG journal.
Class-aware routing and Goldor roles.
Routing failures can no longer crash the game.
Goldor coordination: terminal map, role routes and timed pre-leaps.
Price history shows its hover readout, axis labels and legend.
Price history graphs.
Splits clock and comparisons.
Target level in the tracker.
Richer win screen.
Cape fix.
Score follows Hypixel's sidebar; best possible time from boss entry.
Live dungeon splits, personal bests and best possible time. Versions 2.7.13 to 2.7.19 refined splits.
Bazaar orders sync on co-op profiles and reconcile with the order menu.
Positions grouped by what you need to do next.
Bazaar Assistant parity work and an in-game test suite.
Bazaar Assistant: a guided, step-by-step flip. It never clicks for you.
Tracker records chests that contain Hunting Box shards and master stars.
Smoother teammate previews in the Spirit Leap menu.
Reworked Bazaar terminal, profit accounting and market feed.
